runtime.execution: CLI invokes external Claude sequentially headless or launches independent tmux/macOS terminal sessions.
runtime.service_boundary: Owns brief/roster/launch artifacts and terminal channel; child harness owns provider, tools and context.

summary: Small local historical runner exposes commander-controlled briefs, per-agent options/workdirs, captured headless outputs and tmux watch/say; it is not a general collaboration engine.

inspection.scope: Selected source excerpts trace exposed entry/loop/request/action/result/state boundaries and relevant capability mechanisms; listed tests are read as source only.
inspection.limits: No acquired code executed, dependencies installed or live providers invoked. Claims concern this pinned snapshot; untraced catalog tools and dependency internals are not inferred.

actions.name: list / render <brief> <callsign>
actions.authority: operator/commander owns TOML; prompt constraints no filesystem enforcement

actions.name: dispatch <brief> [callsigns|all] [--dry-run] [--live] [--stream-json] [--max-budget-usd]
actions.input: config, brief, callsigns, optional run dir and dispatch options
actions.lifecycle: headless sequential blocking; live tee threads have 2s join; no timeout/cancel API
actions.authority: config permission mode/auth inherited to external Claude

actions.name: dispatch --windows
actions.output: runner script and launcher metadata, independent terminal sessions
actions.lifecycle: same rt-CALLSIGN tmux killed before new; launcher success does not prove worker finished
actions.authority: operator/model shell command; generated child permission flags

actions.name: status [brief] --json
actions.lifecycle: queries files for current roster, not live child health
actions.authority: local metadata read; no remote provider query

actions.name: channel list / watch CALLSIGN / say CALLSIGN MESSAGE
actions.input: action, callsign, optional lines or literal message
actions.lifecycle: direct terminal injection without busy/idle fence; ignored literal-text error can yield misleading success
actions.authority: bypasses config lookup and addresses predictable rt-CALLSIGN

filesystem.detail: Writes run artifacts/scripts and assigns child workdirs; underlying Claude tools supply actual coding operations.

processes.detail: Headless external child and independent terminal/tmux workers; replacing windows kills existing callsign session.

code_actions.detail: Config and CLI can be composed by commander; generated shell launcher, not a native model-authored tool-program execution runtime.

persistent_kernel.detail: This unversioned Python control script launches external Claude rather than providing a persistent language interpreter.

standing_database.detail: Inspected whole five-file implementation uses prompt/meta/output files, not a standing query database.

workflow_programming.detail: Roster, doctrine, briefs and CLI are editable by commander; no dependency scheduler or workflow resume interpreter. Headless all is sequential.

multi_model.detail: Per-worker --model and effort configure different Claude CLI invocations; no heterogeneous provider adapter or intra-turn collaboration engine.

live_collaboration.detail: Commander can watch/say to window workers via terminal; no mailbox, shared peer room or model-consumption acknowledgment.

concurrent_work.detail: Windowed launches coexist; headless list comprehension waits each worker before next. Tee reader threads only stream one process.

steering_interrupt.detail: Channel say sends literal text plus Enter without idle test or queue; replacing rt-CALLSIGN kills it. No owned cancel/interrupt lifecycle.

turn_redefinition.detail: Brief/system/model/options tune external invocation; inner model/provider turn unchanged and unavailable here.

compaction.detail: No context-manager/compactor in inspected complete runner; external Claude responsibility.

context_repair.detail: Prompt/stdout artifacts exist; runner has no traced restore/projection repair surface.

original_audit.detail: Prompt/stdout/stderr/meta optionally includes Claude JSON stream. Window metadata is launch only, screen not archived; run IDs second-resolution and files overwritten on reused run dir; not full audit.

audit_query.detail: Status projects current-roster file metadata/output size, watch reads live pane; no complete event/search query.

hot_change.detail: Config reread each CLI command; running child keeps passed options. Channel bypasses config; no affected-turn/workflow activation fence.

rebuild_continuity.detail: No compiled harness swap, outpost/context transfer or refit lifecycle in inspected full runner.

remote_services.detail: Consumes external Claude CLI/provider using inherited auth; no remote agent/fabric transport built into script.

self_improvement.detail: Commanding model is instructed to edit roster and doctrine; no governed experiment/evaluation/improvement loop established.

complaints.detail: Brief artifacts/stdout can report blockers; no state-capturing tracked complaint operation established.

authority.detail: External Claude permission-mode option configurable (example bypassPermissions); brief limits are prompt instructions. Channel can target sessions without consulting roster.

evaluation.detail: Entire available implementation and example files read; no test files present in acquired five-source-file tree. Dry-run writes/prints invocation, not behavioral oracle.

time_order.detail: Second-resolution run IDs and start/complete timestamps; no sequence/causality IDs, cancellation fence or child resume.

evidence.claim: Documented CLI/terminal coordination and per-run artifacts; external Claude supplies agent engine.
Config validation, callsign roster/brief selection and rendered prompt; instructions are prompt constraints, not enforcement.
Second-resolution run directory IDs, streaming reader threads and per-agent workdir; no execution timeout/cancel handle.
Window launch generates executable shell runner, kills same-named tmux session, starts new and opens terminal; metadata tracks launcher rc, not worker completion.
Headless dispatch calls Claude -p with model/effort/permissions/optional JSON stream/budget and inherited auth; captures stdout/stderr/meta.
Status reads current-roster metadata and stdout sizes; invalid JSON recorded but removed callsigns excluded.
Channel lists all tmux sessions, watches captured pane and injects literal text then Enter. Text-send error ignored; only Enter rc returned.
Exposed CLI; dispatch list comprehension blocks each headless worker sequentially; windows launch independent sessions; reload is per CLI invocation.
Editable roster/model/workdir/doctrine/permissions/terminal; example has commented agents, so lacks required agents key until configured.

strengths: Per-worker workdir/model/permission config with prompts and return code preserved.
limits: Local unversioned snapshot, no canonical revision or test suite established.
Headless dispatch is sequential; window launch metadata is not completion.
Direct terminal channel lacks turn-boundary queue and can report Enter success after literal send failed.
arconaut_questions: What owned small process API would preserve this directness while making handles/cancel/output/receipt semantics precise?
How should commander programs edit live orchestration without killing existing callsign processes or overwriting run evidence?
